verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs include static reference pages (e.g. the clipboard reference), copy-paste snippets for coding assistants, and an llms.txt index. None of the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable in-browser examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Static reference pages and snippets are adjacent documentation features, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.
